verdict.rationale: BILL's S&E API documents creating virtual cards alongside budgets and users, so the product's own virtual-card capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows those cards can be locked to a single vendor or merchant, or used to isolate SaaS and procurement vendors. The AP 'virtual card' disbursement method is a vendor payout option, not vendor-locked spend cards, so it isn't credited here. Missing for 10: documented single-vendor/merchant locking of virtual cards, per-subscription card creation for SaaS/procurement, card-level spend limits or controls tied to a vendor, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can create single-vendor virtual cards for SaaS subscriptions and procurement so one compromised vendor never exposes shared credit
